summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard commander was temporarily relieved while an investigation proceeds, and the service held an anti-trafficking session in Tuguegarao. China deployed coast guard and naval vessels to four West Philippine Sea sites, prompting legislator Tarriela to condemn the incursions and defend the 2016 arbitral ruling. France and India deepened maritime security cooperation with the Philippines during visits and agreements, while the Philippines considered Brazil's KC-390 transport aircraft. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. hosted U.S. President Donald Trump for a state visit that included defence talks, and the UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den filippinske kystvaktskommandanten ble midlertidig avløst mens en etterforskning pågår, og tjenesten holdt en antitrafikkøkt i Tuguegarao. Kina deployerte kystvakt- og marinefartøy til fire steder i Vestfilippinene, noe som fikk lovgiver Tarriela til å fordømme inntrengningene og forsvare den arbitrasjonsdommen fra 2016. Frankrike og India utdypet maritimt sikkerhetssamarbeid med Filippinene under besøk og avtaler, mens Filippinene vurderte Brasils KC-390 transportfly. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. mottok USAs president Donald Trump på statsbesøk som inkluderte forsvarssamtaler, og UCDP registrerte 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
